acceptance.given: A subprocess capability definition or invocation descriptor is available for inspection.

oracle.expected: The inspected capability definition exposes cwd as a declared field or parameter.
forbidden: A subprocess capability lacks a cwd declaration.
oracle.observable: Unit validation inspects the subprocess capability definition or descriptor schema and records the presence of a cwd field or parameter.

acceptance.then: The subprocess capability has an explicit cwd declaration.
acceptance.when: During unit validation of the subprocess capability definition or invocation descriptor.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the subprocess capability unit selector against a definition or descriptor with no cwd field and verify that validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure subprocess capability descriptors retain an explicit cwd declaration that unit validation can observe.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Descriptor consumers continue receiving the existing cwd value; rollback removes only the declaration-preservation change.

slice_hint.state_transition: A subprocess capability definition transitions from lacking a verified cwd declaration to exposing cwd as an explicit field or parameter.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted unit selector passes after confirming the capability descriptor contains cwd and fails when cwd is absent.
